events.description: New Dendrology is a group exhibition featuring eleven artists whose work contributes to the study of trees, offering new insight and connection bet...
events.details: New Dendrology is a group exhibition featuring eleven artists whose work contributes to the study of trees, offering new insight and connection between humans and their arboreal neighbors. From communing with streets trees through a reading with The New York City Street Tree Tarot deck by Matthew López-Jensen, to the commitment ceremonies officiated by Laura Nova , artworks featured in this exhibition invite you to engage in a new kind of relationship with trees. Featured Artist: Mariel Collard, Karin Giusti, Mark Heller, Anya Hoyer, Ekene Ijeoma, Gail Karlsson, sTo Len, Anthoula Lelekidis, Matthew López-Jensen, Amanda Lovelee, and Laura Nova. Image credit: The Bright Oak, 2019, Matthew López-Jensen

events.details: The Kids in Motion program engages children in active, outdoor play. A NYC Parks staff member leads four to seven hours of free activities in NYC's playgrounds, including organized sports, games, fitness demos, board games, water games, and more! Kias in Motion is a free, drop-in program without registration. Children can head to the playground during the listed hours of operation to participate. events.title: Proximity Exhibition

venue.name: Snug Harbor Cultural Center
venue.address: Newhouse Center for Contemporary Art (Building C)

events.description: Discover PROXIMITY, featuring 10 Snug Harbor studio artists across painting, photography & mixed media. Explore how shared spaces and creative con
events.details: Featuring work by: Erin Butler, Linda Butti, Mary Campbell, Lisa Dahl, Griselda Healy, Craig Manister, Ann Marie McDonnell, Mike Shane, Gayle Tanaka, Martha Trivizas. Celebrating Snug Harbor's longstanding studio program, where artists in residence create new work within its historic buildings, PROXIMITY explores the studio as a generative space: artists working near one another across space, time, and relationship. Spanning painting, photography, and mixed media, PROXIMITY is not defined by a shared aesthetic, but by a condition of closeness. Here, proximity becomes more than a matter of place-it becomes a context through which individual practices develop, intersect, and inform one another. events.title: Candlelight Ghost Tours
events.description: Venture into \"Manhattan's Most Haunted House\" by flickering candlelight to hear chilling tales of otherworldly activity in the house, t
events.details: Doors slam, floorboards creak, voices call into the dead of night. Venture into \"Manhattan's Most Haunted House\" by flickering candlelight to hear chilling - and true - tales of decades of otherworldly activity in the house, the results of years of paranormal investigations - and the latest stunning scientific findings. The Tredwell family lived at 29 East 4th Street for nearly 100 years, and at least eight people died in the house. Reports of strange and inexplicable occurrences have been widespread since Gertrude, the last surviving Tredwell, died in 1933. Is it Gertrude who is watching over her family home? Join us and decide for yourself. 50-minute tours begin every half hour, 6:30 to 9 p.m.

events.title: 2026 Spooky Snug Harbor Tour
events.description: Uncover the darker side of Snug Harbor with Spooky Snug Harbor! Explore chilling tales of mystery, mayhem, and hauntings on a nighttime walking tou...
events.details: Snug Harbor is one of Staten Island's most beautiful historic destinations. And, if the legends are true, one of its most haunted... This fall, join us for \"Spooky Snug Harbor,\" a series of nighttime walking tours aimed at shedding light on Snug Harbor's darkest history.\u202FGuided by local history enthusiast Michael Pelczar, founder of Spooky Staten Island, your tour group will hear never-before-published information. Visitors will also have the opportunity to use ghost-hunting equipment during each tour session. Can we make contact with the other side?\u202F On October 31st 9:00-10:30 Join our Halloween Special Spooky Snug Harbor tour, you'll journey back in time to learn about murder, mayhem, and hauntings at Snug. You will visit the final resting place of Captain Robert Randall, whose wealth willed Snug Harbor into existence. You'll ponder the mystery of Chaplain Quinn's murder, a crime that gripped the nation.&n...

events.title: Super Spooky Candlelight Ghost Tours with Paranormal Investigator Dan Sturges
events.description: Join paranormal investigator Dan Sturges on a 90-minute In-Person Super Spooky Candlelight Ghost Tour for an in-depth look at the latest research a...
events.details: In 2020, the museum closed due to COVID-19, leaving the house empty of staff and visitors. Dan Sturges, who has undertaken paranormal investigations at the Merchant's House for 15 years, teamed up with neuroscientist Dr. Lee to conduct scientific research using specialized equipment custom-built for the house. Mounting fact-based evidence points to the very likely reality of paranormal activity at the Merchant's House. Join paranormal investigator Dan Sturges on a 90-minute In-Person Super Spooky Candlelight Ghost Tour for an in-depth look at the latest research and findings. Dan is the founder of Sturges Paranormal and appears on the Travel Channel's weekly series, Paranormal Caught on Camera. He has performed investigations at the Merchant's House - and documented his spine-chilling findings - since 2007. 90-minute tour begins 9:30 p.m.
